senses.gloss:
तोमर तोमर, अस्, अम्, m. n. an iron club
or crow; a lance, a javelin; a kind of metre con-
sisting of four lines of nine syllables each; N. of a
man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a race.
—तोमर-ग्रह,
अस्, m. a warrior armed with a club or lance; throw-
ing a lance.
—तोमर-धर, अस्, m. a warrior
armed with a club or lance; fire.

तोमराण तोमराण, अस्, m., N. of a man;
[cf. तोरमाण.]

तोमरिका तोमरिका, f. = तुवरिका, a fra-
grant earth.
